description:
LEVELS OF ASSISTANCE AND AUTONOMY Five power levels to manage assistance in the best way guaranteeing exceptional performance to tackle any type of route. MOTOR Limitless power with OLI SPORT PLUS which develops a torque of 85 Nm. This version expresses all the possible power for those who do not want to set limits. The assistance amazes from the first pedal stroke and adapts perfectly to any route, thus allowing the user to concentrate on riding, offering unimaginable sensations. BATTERY BE33 TEASER is equipped with an integrated 630 Wh battery for a range of up to 135 km.

BE GREEN TECHNOLOGIES The 29" frame combines perfectly with the integrated 630 Wh quick release battery and the 250W OLI motor. With a range of up to 150 km and 5 power levels, the electric assistance provides all the support needed to comfortably tackle different routes. The silent and powerful motor can support the cyclist with up to 400% of the force used, and thanks to the extremely sensitive latest generation hi-tech effort sensor, is activated simply by pressing the pedal regardless of rotation. The intelligent assistance is activated according to the pressure exerted on the pedal, so that the progressive engine support automatically adapts to the driving situation. The 85 Nm torque allows you to develop power suitable for tackling any type of route naturally. IDEAL FOR This hardtail is perfect for both having fun on mountain trails and for daily routes and free time. The assistance amazes from the first pedal stroke and adapts perfectly to any route, thus allowing the user to concentrate on driving. PERFECT FOR YOU IF If you are looking for a versatile and reliable bike, capable of easily guiding you on different routes. Comfortable and easy to handle, TEASER is perfect for off-road sports excursions but also for daily journeys where extra support is needed.
